en: Added per-command `allowed_domains` to Bash, PowerShell and Monitor in auto mode with sandboxing: the hosts a command needs are reviewed with it and opened for it alone; other hosts are refused
zh: 在启用沙箱的自动模式下，为 Bash、PowerShell 和 Monitor 新增按命令的 `allowed_domains`：命令所需的 host 会随命令一起审核并仅对该命令开放；其他 host 一律拒绝
